# make: make --no-print-directory -n raun FAULT=kill-history TTL=600 POOL_ADDR=http://127.0.0.1:17700 SCENARIO=throughput_stress RUN_ID=r1 POOL_QUIET_WAIT_S=0
# laug: laug raun kill-history -ttl 10m -pool 127.0.0.1:17700 -scenario throughput_stress -run-id r1 -quiet-wait 0s
# lease: absent
# passes: POOL_QUIET_WAIT_S=0
# compare: line faults/run.sh
[[ 'r1' =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ]] || { echo "laug · make raun: RUN_ID="'r1'" is not one word of letters, digits, ., _ and -, from a letter or digit" >&2; exit 2; }; [[ 'throughput_stress' =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ]] || { echo "laug · make raun: SCENARIO="'throughput_stress'" is not one word of letters, digits, ., _ and -, from a letter or digit" >&2; exit 2; }; [[ 'kill-history' =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ]] || { echo "laug · make raun: FAULT="'kill-history'" is not one word of letters, digits, ., _ and -, from a letter or digit" >&2; exit 2; };                  
make lease
[[ '600' =~ ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]] || { echo "laug · TTL="'600'": a whole number of seconds" >&2; exit 2; }
tmp=$(mktemp .lease.XXXXXX); \
if curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:17700/lease' -H 'content-type: application/json' \
     -d "$(jq -cn --argjson ttl 600 --arg requester 'laug' '{ttl_seconds: $ttl, requester: $requester}')" -o "$tmp"; then \
  mv "$tmp" .last-lease.json && jq . .last-lease.json; \
else rc=$?; echo "laug · lease refused (curl exit $rc): $(cat "$tmp")" >&2; rm -f "$tmp"; exit 1; fi
make fault RUN_ID=raun-r1 FAULT=kill-history; status=$?; make release; exit $status
[[ 'raun-r1' =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ]] || { echo "laug · make fault: RUN_ID="'raun-r1'" is not one word of letters, digits, ., _ and -, from a letter or digit" >&2; exit 2; }; [[ 'throughput_stress' =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ]] || { echo "laug · make fault: SCENARIO="'throughput_stress'" is not one word of letters, digits, ., _ and -, from a letter or digit" >&2; exit 2; }; [[ 'kill-history' =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ]] || { echo "laug · make fault: FAULT="'kill-history'" is not one word of letters, digits, ., _ and -, from a letter or digit" >&2; exit 2; };                  
RUN_ID=raun-r1 POOL_ADDR='http://127.0.0.1:17700' faults/run.sh throughput_stress kill-history
[ -s .last-lease.json ] || { echo "laug · no lease in .last-lease.json; make lease first" >&2; exit 2; }
curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:17700/release' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$(jq '{id}' .last-lease.json)" | jq . \
  && rm -f .last-lease.json
